_readme: Tile rects are [col0,row0,col1,row1] inclusive (64px tiles). First matching rect wins. 'start' is the new-game tile. Gate rects tie X tiles to world.json gates. Layout 3 (tools/build_world_acts.py): Act I is the hand-tuned layout 2 verbatim (cols 0-223, rows 0-91), the canvas grows east and south to 448x208 for Acts II-V; Act I coordinates did not move. 'style' names a look in 'styles' (code tints only, no extra art). 'spawn' is the ?warp= tile. Props: img keys from world.gd PROP_DEFS.
